hints.title: Key-Based Record Merging and Sorting
hints.text: Combining two collections of records sharing an identifier requires merging attributes from later records over earlier records and ordering results by ascending ID.

hints.title: Dictionary Indexing with Attribute Merging
hints.text: Insert all objects from the first array into a dictionary keyed by ID. Iterate through the second array, merging each object into the existing entry or creating a new entry. Extract and sort values by ID.

hints.title: Join Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize map = new Map(). Loop item of arr1: map.set(item.id, { ...item }). Loop item of arr2: if map.has(item.id) Object.assign(map.get(item.id), item); else map.set(item.id, { ...item }). Return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total objects across arr1 and arr2
complexity.notes: Map indexing takes O(N) time; final sorting takes O(N log N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested linear scanning to find matching IDs takes O(N * M) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Map indexing provides constant key lookup before the final sorting step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Ensuring arr2 attributes override arr1 while preserving untouched arr1 properties.
